summary: Frontend-only re-verification of PROSPECTIA login flow on public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL after the transient-error handling fix in Login.jsx + AuthContext.js. All 4 requested scenarios PASS: (1) wrong password -> exact 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' inside data-testid='login-error', no redirect (server returned 401 as expected in console); (2) correct password 'Prospectia2026!' for jp.koffi@prospectia.app -> success, redirected to '/', JWT (232 chars) written to localStorage key 'prospectia_token', KPI 'TOTAL PROSPECTS' visible on dashboard (case-insensitive match confirmed value=15); (3) F5 reload -> user remains logged in, token persists, dashboard re-renders (GET /api/auth/me works); (4) logout via data-testid='logout-btn' clears the token and returns to /login, and re-login with the same credentials succeeds. No regression detected. Fix is confirmed working from browser end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx: status-based error mapping is correct - 401 -> credentials error, 404/502/503/504/5xx/no-response -> 'Service momentanément indisponible...'. Clean and easy to reason about.

AuthContext.js: single automatic retry after 1.5s on transient errors is a minimal but effective mitigation for the uvicorn --reload window. Consider capping to only network/5xx (not 404) in prod so that a genuinely misrouted /api/auth/login does not double-fire, but for a preview/dev preview this is fine.
Session rehydration via GET /api/auth/me on mount + token in localStorage under 'prospectia_token' is consistent and matches memory/test_credentials.md.
Nit: after logout, using window.location.href='/login' forces a full page reload; a React Router navigate('/login') would keep SPA state but this is not a bug.

rca of the issue: Original user report 'Request failed with status code 404' at login was caused by hitting the backend during a uvicorn --reload window. Fix (already applied): (a) Login.jsx maps 401 -> 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' and 404/502/503/504/5xx/network -> 'Service momentanément indisponible. Patientez quelques secondes puis réessayez.', so the user is no longer misled by a transient 404 posing as a credentials error; (b) AuthContext.login auto-retries once after 1.5s on transient errors, which absorbs the reload window in practice. Both behaviors are visible and verified in this iteration.
